label: 40-channel DWDM mux/demux C21-C60, 100GHz, LC/UPC, 1U
description: 40-channel dual-fibre DWDM mux/demux on the 100 GHz C-band grid C21-C60 (1560.61 nm down to 1529.55 nm, 0.8 nm spacing), with 40 duplex LC/UPC channel ports, a duplex LC/UPC line port and a 1310 nm band-pass port for 40G/100G LR4 optics. Flat-top AWG: insertion loss <=5.5 dB per channel (4.5 dB typical), 1310 nm port <=1.5 dB, return loss >=40 dB, passive.
